resources.string: A button over other apps for the keyboard, voice typing, AI and any tool
A small round button floats over every app

A small round button floats over every app, with the keyboard open or closed. Tap it, double tap it or press and hold it, and it does what you set below: open the keyboard, even on a screen with no text field, start voice typing, ask the AI about the screen, or open any tool. Press and hold opens a quick menu of more actions round the button; slide onto one and let go to run it. Drag the button to move it, and it settles against the nearer side. Drag it onto the cross at the bottom of the screen to hide it until the keyboard next opens or closes. Needs Android\'s Display over other apps permission.
Let the button read the screen
Ask AI can bring the text on screen with it, and Look up can find the word you tap, once the screen reading service is on
Off. Turn the button on to see it over your apps.

Each gesture runs one action. A tool that lives on the keyboard, such as voice typing or the clipboard, brings the keyboard up first when it is closed. With a double tap set, a single tap waits a moment to make sure no second tap is coming.

The quick menu fans out round the button, facing the middle of the screen. Opened by pressing and holding, slide your finger onto an action and let go to run it, or let go first and tap one. Tap anywhere else to close it. Drag the handles to reorder; the first action sits at one end of the fan.
